new_categories.label: treatment_equipment_readiness
new_categories.memory: Active hold dehumidification/drying equipment readiness is a delivered service-state distinct from passive ventilation and from atmosphere sensing.

new_categories.label: air_treatment_supply_confidence
new_categories.memory: Availability of treated/drying air or equivalent drying effect can be represented separately from equipment readiness without retaining exact process parameters.

new_categories.label: distribution_path_confidence
new_categories.memory: Distribution-path confidence from treatment source to bounded hold/zone is distinct from the treatment equipment itself and can degrade independently.

new_categories.label: hold_zone_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: Drying-treatment service can be bounded to a hold or zone without retaining duct layouts, openings, hose routes or exact airflow arrangements.

new_categories.label: support_dependency_confidence
new_categories.memory: Electrical, thermal, air-moving, drainage or control support can be represented as aggregate dependency confidence without retaining actual support-system lineups or operating settings.

new_categories.label: non_numeric_treatment_effect_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-numeric confidence that drying/dehumidification effect is being delivered can be retained without humidity, dew-point, temperature or airflow targets.

new_categories.label: monitoring_verification_confidence
new_categories.memory: Monitoring/verification confidence is distinct from treatment delivery and can degrade without retaining actual readings, thresholds, trends or test values.

new_categories.label: independent_cross_check_confidence
new_categories.memory: Independent cross-check confidence can be represented separately from equipment status and primary atmosphere indications.

new_categories.label: condensation_risk_effect_not_service_equivalence
new_categories.memory: Condensation-risk confidence or cargo-care concern is a downstream effect and is not equivalent to treatment equipment, supply, distribution or verification state.

new_categories.label: drying_service_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: Drying/dehumidification service can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-restoration and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_restriction_and_isolation
new_categories.memory: Restriction/isolation can attach separately to equipment, treatment supply, distribution path, support dependency, hold/zone scope or verification state.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Condensation concern, cargo-work restriction, hold unavailability, rework or schedule effects do not prove an equipment, treatment-supply, distribution, support or hold-scope root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_drying_restoration
new_categories.memory: Equipment correction, support restoration, distribution recovery, treatment-effect verification, restriction release and hold return-to-service can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: ventilation_vs_active_drying_treatment
useful_refinements.memory: P089 ventilation/air exchange does not duplicate active dehumidification or drying-air treatment service.

useful_refinements.label: monitoring_vs_treatment_delivery
useful_refinements.memory: P110 temperature/humidity monitoring establishes observation confidence, not active drying-treatment delivery.

useful_refinements.label: generic_hvac_vs_hold_drying_scope
useful_refinements.memory: Generic shipboard HVAC/environmental support does not establish delivered dry-cargo hold dehumidification/drying service for a bounded hold scope.

useful_refinements.label: generic_equipment_lifecycle_vs_delivered_drying_service
useful_refinements.memory: P067 generic lifecycle/support semantics do not establish delivered dehumidification/drying service readiness.

duplicates.label: generic_supply_distribution_support_verification_pattern
duplicates.memory: Generic source/supply, distribution, support dependency and verification mechanics repeat prior service-state families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_downstream_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic scope localization, downstream-effect separation and multi-stage verified restoration are already campaign-wide.

exact distribution arrangements, duct/hose paths, control modes, alarm settings, sensor values, trend values, test readings or acceptance limits
exact startup, alignment, operation, adjustment, cargo-care, testing, troubleshooting, shutdown, isolation or emergency procedures
named equipment makers, service providers, ports, yards, cargo incidents, claims, findings or current-readiness facts
negative_space: exact equipment types, capacities, airflow, temperatures, humidity/dew-point targets, distribution arrangements, support-system settings and current configuration
exact control logic, alarm settings, sensor/trend values, test readings, acceptance criteria and cargo-specific targets
exact startup, alignment, operation, adjustment, cargo-care, testing, troubleshooting, shutdown, isolation or emergency procedures
named makers, service providers, ports, yards, cargo incidents, claims, findings, current readiness and private/regional/non-English lineages
stop_reason: The bounded active dehumidification/drying-service questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact equipment, humidity/dew-point targets, capacities, airflow/control settings, cargo-care procedures, providers or incidents that are deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive dry-cargo hold dehumidification/drying service orientation and source-discovery output; not equipment-operation or cargo-care guidance and not proof of any exact target, capacity, arrangement, setting, procedure, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
